item.title: Don’t come home otherwise I’ll kill you: Man to be deported after threatening wife
item.description: Upon admission of guilt, the court sentenced the man to 14 months’ imprisonment suspended for two years and imposed a €400 fine, as well as his immediate deportation

item.title: PN: NGOs linked to Michelle Muscat given preferential treatment
item.description: Opposition says report confirms preferential treatment after civil servants were seconded beyond legal limits to organisations chaired by Michelle Muscat

item.title: Drag racing association official blasts slow progress on quarter-mile track
item.description: Secretary general of the Malta Drag Racing Association says only around 40% of works are complete a year after warning of delays, accusing authorities of betraying Maltese motorsport

item.title: Court hands out seven-year prison term for man who left diner blind in one eye
item.description: The accused punched the victim for no apparent reason

item.title: Carnival finale cancelled as orange weather warning brings gale-force winds
item.description: Events organised by Festivals Malta were called off after authorities warned of dangerous winds and seas, with ferry services suspended and workers urged to avoid exposed areas

item.title: Boat owners no longer need to remove vessels from AUM water space
item.description: Momentum urged that the full details of the agreement reportedly reached between Bedingfield, the government and AUM be made public

item.title: Authorities called for assistance after Msida scaffolding collapses
item.description: The BCA once again urged the public to remove all temporary structures and machinery that might be dangerous in such strong winds

item.title: It’s time to move beyond the glitz
item.description: We hope that the plans, the ideas and the glossy brochures will, in the short term, translate into beautiful, sustainable concrete projects that benefit the common good above all else

item.title: Corinthia’s Għajn Tuffieħa luxury enclave recommended for approval
item.description: The transformation of the former Ħal Ferħ complex in Għajn Tuffieħa into a luxury resort that includes a hotel and a villa enclave is set for approval

item.title: Students sitting for more subjects in SEC exams
item.description: New assessment model and school registrations could be driving students to diversify their choices according to MATSEC report
